sessionStart.bash: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook copilot session-start 2>/dev/null; exit 0

postToolUse.bash: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook copilot post-tool 2>/dev/null; exit 0

agentStop.bash: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook copilot stop 2>/dev/null; exit 0

sessionEnd.bash: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/plinth-mentions.mjs" hook copilot session-end 2>/dev/null; exit 0
